# Default document paths

Documents are organized by test name below testdata/markdiff. Subtests become directories, and characters that are awkward in file names are replaced with underscores.

| Test name | Document path |
| --- | --- |
| `TestFoo` | `testdata/markdiff/TestFoo.md` |
| `TestFoo/bar` | `testdata/markdiff/TestFoo/bar.md` |
| `TestFoo/with_spaces/#01` | `testdata/markdiff/TestFoo/with_spaces/_01.md` |
| `TestFoo/a:b*c?` | `testdata/markdiff/TestFoo/a_b_c_.md` |
| `TestFoo/..` | `testdata/markdiff/TestFoo/__.md` |
